# PhraseCut

> Learn words from sentences you like. Paste your text or explore English article excerpts by interest; translate, practice listening, and export vocabulary online. Save and review in the native app.

The free website recommends excerpts from updating Wikipedia, Global Voices, NASA, and Wikivoyage sources, with original links and licenses. Recommendations are currently in English; pasted text supports 20 translation languages. Refreshing the source cache does not mean an article was published today.

The website has no saved history, review library or AI explanations. Native apps save sentence context, translations, language pairs and notes locally, and provide lightweight spaced review with optional local reminders that require notification permission. Native offline Apple Translation needs a supported source/target pair and installed language packs. Downloads and new recommendations require internet access. Optional sentence explanations require iOS 26/macOS 26 or later, eligible Apple Intelligence hardware, the feature enabled and a ready system model; availability varies. CSV/Anki CSV exports are files for manual import, not automatic account sync or APKG decks. Consult the App Store listing for current platform/region availability rather than a screenshot's version label. This file is an optional navigation aid, not a sitemap, robots policy, or Google ranking requirement.

## Product

- [Product facts](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/product-facts.md): Feature and release boundaries, content sources, freshness, languages, translation providers, and CSV attribution.
- [Online tool](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/study): Interest-based English excerpts, sentence and word translation, adjustable pronunciation, CSV and Anki CSV export.
- [Help](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/help): Native app learning and review workflow.

## Localized app help

- [English](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/help): Use PhraseCut on iPhone, iPad and Mac: save context, review due vocabulary and export CSV. Check offline language packs and optional Apple Intelligence requirements.
- [简体中文](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/zh-hans/help): 了解 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 版 PhraseCut：保存带语境的词汇、到期复习、导出 CSV，以及离线语言包和可选 Apple Intelligence 句子解释的使用条件。
- [繁體中文](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/zh-hant/help): 了解 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 版 PhraseCut：儲存有情境的單字、到期複習、匯出 CSV，以及離線語言套件和選用 Apple Intelligence 句子解說的使用條件。
- [हिन्दी](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/hi/help): iPhone, iPad और Mac पर संदर्भ सहेजना, समय पर दोहराना और CSV निर्यात सीखें। ऑफ़लाइन भाषा पैक और वैकल्पिक Apple Intelligence की शर्तें जानें।
- [Indonesia](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/id/help): Pelajari pustaka lokal, jadwal ulasan dan ekspor CSV di iPhone, iPad, dan Mac, termasuk syarat paket bahasa offline dan penjelasan Apple Intelligence opsional.
- [Tiếng Việt](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/vi/help): Tìm hiểu cách lưu ngữ cảnh, ôn tập và xuất CSV trên iPhone, iPad và Mac, cùng điều kiện gói ngôn ngữ ngoại tuyến và Apple Intelligence tùy chọn.
- [Português](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/pt-br/help): Saiba como salvar contexto, revisar e exportar CSV no iPhone, iPad e Mac, com os requisitos de idiomas offline e explicações opcionais por Apple Intelligence.
- [Français](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/fr/help): Utilisez PhraseCut sur iPhone, iPad et Mac : conservez le contexte, révisez les mots à revoir et exportez en CSV. Consultez les conditions des packs hors ligne et d'Apple Intelligence en option.
- [Deutsch](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/de/help): PhraseCut auf iPhone, iPad und Mac: Kontext speichern, fällige Vokabeln wiederholen und CSV exportieren. Beachten Sie die Voraussetzungen für Offline-Sprachpakete und optionales Apple Intelligence.
- [Español](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/es/help): Usa PhraseCut en iPhone, iPad y Mac: guarda el contexto, repasa el vocabulario pendiente y exporta CSV. Consulta los requisitos de los paquetes sin conexión y de Apple Intelligence opcional.
- [日本語](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/ja/help): iPhone、iPad、MacのPhraseCutで文脈を保存し、復習時期の来た語彙を学び、CSVを書き出す方法。オフライン用言語パックと任意のApple Intelligence機能の要件も確認できます。
- [한국어](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/ko/help): iPhone, iPad, Mac에서 PhraseCut으로 문맥을 저장하고, 복습하고, CSV를 내보내는 방법을 알아보세요. 오프라인 언어 팩과 선택형 Apple Intelligence 기능의 이용 조건도 확인하세요.

## Localized tools

- [English](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/study): Translate sentences and words free online. Explore English excerpts from updating sources by interest, repeat pronunciation, and export CSV or Anki CSV. No account.
- [简体中文](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/zh-hans/study): 免费在线整句与逐词翻译，按兴趣从持续更新的公开来源获取英文摘句、调速朗读，并导出 CSV 或 Anki CSV。无需注册，也可粘贴其他外语文本学习词汇。
- [繁體中文](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/zh-hant/study): 免費線上整句與逐字翻譯，依興趣從持續更新的公開來源取得英文摘句、調速朗讀，並匯出 CSV 或 Anki CSV。不需註冊，也可貼上其他外語文字學習單字。
- [हिन्दी](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/hi/study): मुफ्त वाक्य और शब्द अनुवाद करें। अपडेट होते स्रोतों से रुचि के अनुसार अंग्रेज़ी अंश चुनें, उच्चारण दोहराकर सुनें और CSV या Anki CSV निर्यात करें। खाता जरूरी नहीं।
- [Indonesia](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/id/study): Terjemahkan kalimat dan kata gratis. Pilih kutipan Inggris dari sumber yang terus diperbarui, ulangi pelafalan, dan ekspor CSV atau Anki CSV. Tanpa akun.
- [Tiếng Việt](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/vi/study): Dịch câu và từng từ miễn phí. Chọn trích đoạn tiếng Anh từ nguồn được cập nhật, nghe lặp lại và xuất CSV hoặc Anki CSV. Không cần tài khoản.
- [Português](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/pt-br/study): Traduza frases e palavras grátis. Explore trechos em inglês de fontes atualizadas, repita a pronúncia e exporte CSV ou Anki CSV. Sem criar conta.
- [Français](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/fr/study): Traduisez gratuitement des phrases et des mots en ligne. Explorez des extraits en anglais de sources actualisées selon vos intérêts, répétez la prononciation et exportez au format CSV ou Anki CSV. Sans compte.
- [Deutsch](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/de/study): Sätze und Wörter kostenlos online übersetzen. Entdecken Sie englische Auszüge aus aktualisierten Quellen nach Interesse, wiederholen Sie die Aussprache und exportieren Sie CSV oder Anki CSV. Ohne Konto.
- [Español](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/es/study): Traduce frases y palabras gratis en línea. Explora fragmentos en inglés de fuentes que se actualizan según tus intereses, repite la pronunciación y exporta CSV o Anki CSV. Sin cuenta.
- [日本語](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/ja/study): 文章と単語を無料でオンライン翻訳。更新される情報源から興味に合った英語の抜粋を探し、発音を繰り返し聞いて、CSVやAnki CSVを書き出せます。アカウント不要。
- [한국어](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/ko/study): 문장과 단어를 온라인에서 무료로 번역하세요. 갱신되는 출처에서 관심사별 영어 발췌문을 찾고, 발음을 반복해 듣고, CSV나 Anki CSV로 내보내세요. 계정이 필요 없습니다.
